title: Owl waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='45' height='7' rx='3' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='45' height='3' rx='2' fill='#A9703E'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#7A5230'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='16' ry='19' fill='#D9B382'/>
  <!-- belly feather marks -->
  <path d='M42 60 q4 4 8 0 M50 60 q4 4 8 0 M44 70 q4 4 8 0 M52 70 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#B98F5E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- wing (left, at side) -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='62' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#5E3D22'/>
  <!-- raised waving wing -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='40' rx='8' ry='15' transform='rotate(-35 76 40)' fill='#5E3D22'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='27' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#6E4A2A'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M40 84 l-8 8 l12 -2 z' fill='#5E3D22'/>
  <path d='M60 84 l8 8 l-12 -2 z' fill='#5E3D22'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='21' ry='18' fill='#8A5E36'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <path d='M33 22 l4 -10 l6 8 z' fill='#6E4A2A'/>
  <path d='M67 22 l-4 -10 l-6 8 z' fill='#6E4A2A'/>
  <!-- face disc -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='10' fill='#E8C99B'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='10' fill='#E8C99B'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='6' fill='#FFD54A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='6' fill='#FFD54A'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='3' fill='#2B2B3A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='3' fill='#2B2B3A'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='32' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M50 40 l-5 6 h10 z' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <!-- feet on branch -->
  <path d='M42 82 v-3 M42 79 l-4 2 M42 79 l0 3 M42 79 l4 2' stroke='#FF8C42' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 82 v-3 M58 79 l-4 2 M58 79 l0 3 M58 79 l4 2' stroke='#FF8C42' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- wave lines -->
  <path d='M86 18 l3 -4 M90 26 l5 -1 M84 30 l2 4' stroke='#FFD54A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
